domains.name: estate/<host>/<owner>, platform/<host> or federation/<name> of a chora (CHORA-SPEC section 9)
domains.purpose: the opaque ids of estate, platform and federation choras (owner ruling 2026-11-12, confirming C9 at version 8)

domains.name: github.com/<owner>/<name> of a repository: its birth path
domains.purpose: repo chora ids minted after owner ruling V9 (2026-11-13), which moved new mints from gv-clade-index on the registry rename; ids minted earlier keep their gv-clade-index id (rule U1)

domains.name: JCS (RFC 8785) of the JSON object {claim, context, prover, repo} of a proof obligation
domains.purpose: ProofObligationRecord.id in echidnabot: resubmitting the same obligation gives the same id

domains.name: github.com/<owner>/<name> of the repository hosting the package
domains.purpose: the UUIDv8 identity of an unregistered Julia package's own uuid field (Project.toml top-level): minted at repo-init, deterministic across re-mints (ADR-008 amendment D320 requires unregistered packages at v8; profile C keeps the old v5 mint's stability)

domains.name: JCS (RFC 8785) of the goal text as a JSON string, exact text, not trimmed or normalised
domains.purpose: the cross-tool content address of a proof goal: one goal has one id in every tool that names it

domains.name: JCS (RFC 8785) of an ECHIDNA prove result as serialised by the consumer
domains.purpose: ProofReceipt.result_id in proof-burrower: identical prove results share an id

domains.name: github.com/<owner>/<name>#<role> of a document a repository deed registers in its (documents) clause; <role> is the document's stable role symbol, not its path
domains.purpose: the stable id of a repository document, so a moved or removed page can be traced through the deed (rsr-template-repo internal-links check); a mint rewrites <owner>/<name>, giving the new repository its own ids
